value.rationale: The exact trace-free harmonic norm is a structural nullspace criterion for stochastic orientation error of the established full-frame estimator; nonzero radial-linear cubic perturbations unexpectedly have zero frame variance. A sharp sixth-power localization frontier determines when random directions versus canonical axes have lower mean-square error with identical 2n evaluation budgets, including independent measurement noise, and both reversed rankings occur at actual globally strongly convex minimizers. The precise tensor and threshold answer a motivated estimator design issue not supplied by generic O(delta^4) error bounds; no claim is made for optimization trajectories.
